# Changelog

## Unreleased
- Added a lightweight Orus language server that returns keyword documentation on hover inside VS Code
- Expanded keyword scopes, builtin detection, constants, types, variables, and function-call highlighting so every Orus construct receives a token colour
- Replaced the bundled theme with an One Dark Pro-inspired palette and matching default token customizations
- Italicized control keywords and comments to mirror the One Dark flow emphasis
- Restored the Orus icon theme (Seti-based) so `.orus` files can show the logo when you opt into it

## 0.1.1
- Broadened VS Code compatibility so `.orus` files highlight correctly on older editor builds

## 0.1.0
- Initial release with syntax highlighting, language configuration, and Orus snippets
- Added commands to run the active file and create a starter script
- Bundled Orus logo for marketplace listing
